short_description:
GTA 6 update 1.002.002 started rolling out on Nov 23, 2026 (about 600 MB on PS5; Xbox players report 1.2-1.6 GB). It's the third update after 1.002.000 (Nov 13, about 1.07 GB on PS5) and 1.002.001 (Nov 16, about 602 MB), and Rockstar hasn't published patch notes for any of them. What do you think it fixed?

Sources: MP1st, PlayStation LifeStyle, Sportskeeda, GGRecon, Of Zen and Computing, Forbes.
